messages.text: BL-1867 🎵 in progress — The BL-1039 shared-repo fixture seeds a new template on every copy and never removes it in a vitest worker: one test file of 11 tests leaves 11 bl1039-seed-template dirs, and /tmp held 445,231 of them on 2026-10-01 (about 76 GB and 18M of the root filesystem's inodes, growing about 40,000 a day); a process now seeds one template and a run leaves none behind
